evals.name: audit-current-little-things-by-name
evals.prompt: audit the demo for the little things — should be live at https://181bdf65.the-little-things-balloon-garlands-event.pages.dev. what's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Punch list table identifying the OLD navy-palette site's issues: fallback navy palette (high), raw HOME_GOODS_STORE slug (medium), possibly the floating rating chip (medium). Should not invent issues that aren't there.

evals.name: audit-url-only-broken-build
evals.prompt: https://example.com — check this site for anti-patterns
evals.expected_output: Should detect 'empty_render' (no balloon-business content / no h1 / no relevant title) and report the site doesn't appear to be one of our generated leads — punt gracefully, don't hallucinate findings.

evals.name: audit-by-lead-uuid
evals.expected_output: Resolves UUID to The Little Things lead, pulls demo_url from Supabase, runs audit, reports findings. Same output shape as test 1.

evals.name: audit-lead-with-no-demo
evals.prompt: audit the lead 'pretend business that has no demo'
evals.expected_output: Either no matching lead (exit cleanly with 'no lead matched') OR matches a lead with null demo_url and reports 'this lead hasn't been deployed yet, nothing to audit'. Should NOT proceed to screenshotting nothing.
